artifacts.caption: Evidence used for check-level judgement.
artifacts.condition: prefers-color-scheme: dark, prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, prefers-contrast: more

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference does not suppress ongoing animation.
findings.evidence: The evaluate probe under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce found eight running animations, each with a 2,000 ms duration, and the CSS scan found no reduced-motion media rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce branch that removes non-essential animation and disables auto-advance.

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences are not explicitly supported.
findings.evidence: The stylesheet scan found color-scheme rules only, with no prefers-contrast or forced-colors handling; Lighthouse also measured age-banner contrast as low as 1.75:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast styles for text, controls, focus indicators, and scrollbars.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no view-transition rules or names even though document.startViewTransition is available.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for route and major state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Page chrome does not respond to scroll position.
findings.evidence: The long listing has fixed header and navigation chrome, while the CSS probe found no scroll-state query, progress indicator, or scroll timeline.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries or a lightweight progress/shrinking-header pattern to preserve orientation.

findings.summary: The cookie notice obscures the primary content on first load.
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots of the home and category pages show a large centered consent panel covering the listing before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, content-preserving consent surface where legally possible and retain equally prominent accept and reject actions.

findings.summary: Overlays use custom dialog markup instead of native primitives.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found zero dialog, popover, and details elements; signup uses a custom role=dialog surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog for modal consent and account flows, and popover for transient menus, with declarative light dismiss where appropriate.

findings.summary: Navigation and promotional chrome crowd the content.
findings.evidence: The desktop screenshot shows two header rows, an age-verification banner, a persistent sidebar, filters, and the consent panel competing with the video grid.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse secondary chrome, reserve persistent space for the primary journey, and defer promotional surfaces.

findings.summary: The desktop layout is forced into a 360 px viewport.
findings.evidence: At 360x800, layout metrics reported scrollWidth 1024, clientWidth 360, and 664 px horizontal overflow; the screenshot shows most content clipped off-screen.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the 1024 px layout constraint and use fluid intrinsic sizing so the visual viewport and layout viewport agree.

findings.summary: Reusable components do not adapt at container level.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no container query rules; the clipped mobile state shows desktop-sized header, sidebar, banner, and grid components.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare component containment and add size-aware container queries for navigation, cards, banners, and sidebars.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and small controls are not reliably usable.
findings.evidence: Programmatic focus on the first link produced outline-style none and no box shadow; a DOM probe counted 20 visible controls smaller than 24x24 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible styling and increase interactive hit areas to at least the applicable WCAG target-size minimum.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP misses the good threshold.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 3.9 s, while the independent trace measured 1.74 s under a different run, showing condition-sensitive loading performance.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP content, reduce server and render delay, and continuously measure mobile field LCP and INP.

findings.summary: The initial network graph is script-heavy.
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 143 requests and 1.79 MB transferred, including 62 scripts totaling 1.02 MB and three VeryHigh-priority parser-inserted stylesheets.
findings.suggestedFix: Split route code, load optional integrations conditionally, and shorten critical CSS and network dependency chains.

findings.summary: The mobile page ships avoidable unused code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 26 KiB unused JavaScript and 56 KiB unused CSS, with two stylesheets about 90 to 95 percent unused.
findings.suggestedFix: Tree-shake and route-split JavaScript and CSS, and avoid loading desktop or optional feature styles on the entry path.

findings.summary: At least one button has no accessible name.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility found an unnamed button in the content filter list; the images primitive also found one image without alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every interactive control a programmatic name and provide meaningful alt text or empty alt for decorative images.

findings.summary: Important text fails WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 1.75:1 and 2.15:1 text in the age banner, 3.29:1 view counts, and 4.04:1 subscription text.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground and surface tokens to meet WCAG AA in both themes and verify all component states.

findings.summary: Visible keyboard focus is missing on a primary link.
findings.evidence: The focus probe returned outline none and no box shadow for the focused anchor, despite otherwise useful main, nav, header, footer, and heading structure.
findings.suggestedFix: Define a consistent high-contrast :focus-visible indicator and test the full tab order through navigation, consent, listing, and signup.

findings.summary: The page does not reflow on a narrow viewport and sampled media has no caption track.
findings.evidence: The 360 px audit showed 664 px overflow and 20 undersized controls; the sampled video-detail probe found no track elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix responsive reflow, enlarge targets, preserve user scaling, and provide captions or an equivalent for spoken media.

findings.summary: Image markup does not consistently reserve or right-size media.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 29 of 36 images missing width or height, 12 oversized images, 8 below-fold images without lazy loading, and 16 legacy-format URLs.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic dimensions, generate accurate responsive candidates, lazy-load below-fold media, and serve modern formats consistently.

findings.summary: The entry page is crawlable but not mobile-friendly.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse confirmed crawlable links, valid robots, and viewport metadata, but direct mobile layout evidence showed 664 px horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the valid indexing setup and repair narrow-screen reflow so mobile users and mobile-first indexing receive a usable layout.

findings.summary: Localized pages do not expose hreflang links.
findings.evidence: The Polish home page has a canonical URL and valid robots policy but the metadata probe found zero hreflang links despite links to more than 40 locale hosts.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit reciprocal hreflang annotations, including x-default where appropriate, and keep sitemap and canonical signals aligned.

findings.summary: Entity metadata is incomplete.
findings.evidence: The home page had no JSON-LD or Open Graph tags; the sampled video detail had seven Open Graph tags but no JSON-LD VideoObject.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org JSON-LD for the organisation, listings, and VideoObject detail pages, plus complete social preview metadata.

findings.summary: Two first-party cookies are missing Secure.
findings.evidence: The cookie audit found settings and x_csrf_token without Secure; settings also uses SameSite=None. HTTPS, HSTS, CSP, and frame protection were present.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark all HTTPS cookies Secure, use the narrowest workable SameSite value, and review whether script access is necessary.

findings.summary: The pre-consent page has a broad third-party request footprint.
findings.evidence: The HAR attributed 117 of 143 requests and 1.68 MB of 1.79 MB to other origins; the tracker probe observed 14 third-party origins, including accounts.google.com and an ad syndication origin.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay non-essential integrations until consent and user intent, consolidate first-party CDN ownership signals, and minimise identifiers and background collection.

findings.summary: Authentication offers federated and password flows but no passkey path.
findings.evidence: The signup surface offers Google, X, and email/password; the auth probe found no WebAuthn or passkey affordance and no permission request on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey registration and authentication while retaining recovery and federated choices; continue requesting permissions only in context.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced policy coverage is incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers lacked X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy; CSP only defined frame-ancestors, and Permissions-Policy only named two client-hint features.
findings.suggestedFix: Add nosniff and a strict Referrer-Policy, expand CSP beyond framing, and explicitly deny unneeded powerful features.

findings.summary: The localized layout relies heavily on physical CSS directions.
findings.evidence: The page correctly sets html lang=pl, but the stylesheet scan counted about 700 physical left/right declarations and only a small number of logical-property uses across a site offering RTL languages.
findings.suggestedFix: Use inline/block logical properties, set dir for RTL locales, and regression-test mirrored navigation, cards, overlays, and forms.

findings.summary: Rejecting optional cookies leaves a persistent prompt to accept all cookies.
findings.evidence: After choosing Odrzuć, the signup flow displayed a message that some features may be unavailable and continued to present Akceptuj wszystkie pliki cookie.
findings.suggestedFix: Respect rejection without repeated pressure; keep preference management available without a persistent accept-all call to action.

findings.summary: Signup errors are visible but not announced programmatically.
findings.evidence: Submitting the empty email form produced clear Polish messages, but the probe found no role=alert or populated aria-live region and no aria-invalid state.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate each message with its field, set aria-invalid after interaction, and announce the error summary through a polite live region.

findings.summary: Email signup disables useful autofill.
findings.evidence: The expanded signup form exposes two email inputs with autocomplete=off; only the password input uses autocomplete=new-password.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=email or username for the intended email field, remove duplicate hidden inputs from the accessibility path, and retain new-password.

findings.summary: Many thumbnails are oversized or lack responsive delivery metadata.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 12 oversized images, 29 without dimensions, 3 without srcset, and 16 legacy-format URLs.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate correctly sized AVIF or WebP candidates, accurate srcset and sizes values, and intrinsic dimensions.

findings.summary: Third-party code dominates initial transferred bytes.
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 1.68 MB from third-party origins, including 1.08 MB from the static CDN classification and 122 KB from Google accounts before the primary flow needed sign-in.
findings.suggestedFix: Classify related-party CDNs explicitly, defer optional identity and advertising resources, and enforce route-specific budgets.

findings.summary: The entry page has a large initial object graph.
findings.evidence: The baseline heap summary contained 682,503 nodes, 3.20 million edges, and 36.7 MB of self size for a listing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Virtualise or defer offscreen listing content, conditionally load integrations, and track heap and DOM budgets over long sessions.
